build.name: dev
build.summary: start the local WordPress site and rebuild on change; --url is the address a proxy serves it at, --host an address of this machine to listen on

build.name: dev stop
build.summary: stop the local site, keeping its data

build.name: build
build.summary: write the WordPress plugins to sp/dist/wp-content

build.name: export
build.summary: write sp/app/ as a static site to sp/dist/static (output: "static"); --site renders a hosted site's content, signed in as an editor

build.name: check
build.summary: compile and report problems; --fix applies lint auto-fixes

build.name: add
build.summary: add a module to the project as files you own; never overwrites one. Modules: shop (WooCommerce storefront), db (SQL tables), api-reference (pages at /api documenting the HTTP API)

build.name: doctor
build.summary: check a build, and a running site (signed in as an administrator to see what it loads); --links follows every link and #anchor its pages make

build.name: init
build.summary: write AGENTS.md, .mcp.json and the agent skills for this project; --github adds the content sync workflow; --check exits 1 when they are out of date

build.name: mcp
build.summary: serve the project to a coding agent as an MCP server on stdio

build.name: pull
build.summary: write a site's runtime schema versions to sp/_generated/runtime-schema.json, signed in as an administrator

build.name: styles pull
build.summary: write a site's Global Styles (the Styles screen, the Site Editor) over sp/theme.json; the build ships it and generates sp/_generated/theme.css

build.name: abilities pull
build.summary: lock a site's abilities into sp/_generated/abilities.json

build.name: plugin
build.summary: write the SpacePress WordPress plugin (spacepress.zip) to upload and activate in wp-admin

build.name: login
build.summary: sign in to a WordPress site that runs the SpacePress plugin; the site's owner approves an application password in the browser, and every command that talks to the site uses it

build.name: logout
build.summary: forget a site's credential on this machine

build.name: push
build.summary: compile the project and deploy it to the site: install the plugins it needs, upload the build, show what it changes, make it live

site.name: wp
site.summary: any WP-CLI command (spacepress wp plugin list)

site.name: migrate
site.summary: apply pending database migrations, checked against live rows

site.name: danger
site.args: status | plan | drop-column <table> <col> | drop-table <table> | purge-deleted <kind> | raw-sql (requires spacepress/danger)
site.summary: CLI-only destructive cleanup escape hatch (two-phase retired drops, purge, audit log)

site.name: jobs
site.args: list [--state=s] | run <id> | retry <id> | cancel <id> | maintain | tick [--limit=n] [--budget-ms=ms]

site.name: schema
site.summary: the site's runtime schema versions (runtimeSchema: true)

site.name: action
site.summary: call an action as the trusted CLI

site.name: git-dispatch
site.summary: the repository a save of synced content notifies; --token reads the token from stdin into WordPress's Secrets API

site.name: publish-due
site.summary: publish scheduled records that are due

site.name: staged
site.args: list [<kind>] | show|compare|discard <kind> <id> | stage <kind> <id> <json> | promote <kind> <id> [--at=<ISO time> | --cancel] (writes take --rev=<token>)
site.summary: staged versions of post kinds: list, stage, compare, promote, discard

site.name: identity
site.args: account|suspend|restore|revoke|erase <user-id> | app add --name=n --redirect=uri --origin=o [--id=app_id] | agent add <user> --name=n [--write] [--personal] [--abilities=a,b] | agent list <user> | agent grant <user> <id> [--write] [--personal] [--abilities=a,b] | agent revoke <user> <id> | webhook-add <url> | webhook-remove <id> | webhooks | maintenance | rotate-keys
site.summary: SpacePress Identity accounts, applications, agent credentials, webhooks and keys
